text: A股军工板块逆势拉升，长城军工逼近涨停，航天南湖涨超13%，北方长龙、晟楠科技、国科军工、内蒙一机、建设工业等快速跟涨。
text_en: The A-share defense sector bucked the trend and rallied, with Great Wall Military Industry approaching the daily limit, Aerospace Nanhu rising over 13%, and Beifang Changlong, Shengnan Technology, Guoke Military Industry, Inner Mongolia First Machinery, and Construction Industry quickly following the gains.
